text:
Hi Allie! I'm Sarah — I just joined the department this term. I don't think we've met yet, but Jordan's mentioned you and I hear you're the person who actually makes things happen around here.

Would you be up for hosting a small get-together at your place this Saturday? Around 3:30 maybe — something easy, coffee and snacks, nothing elaborate. And it'd be fun to have Jordan there too if he's free, so feel free to invite him along. Just an idea, no pressure at all if Saturday doesn't work.

Hi Sarah — good to meet you, and welcome to the department! Saturday at 3:30 works for me, and coffee and snacks at my place sounds just right. I'll ask Jordan now and let you know what he says. See you Saturday.

Hey Jordan — Sarah (the new grad student) is up for a small get-together at my place this Saturday, around 3:30: coffee and snacks, nothing elaborate. She'd like you there too. Are you free then? Let me know and I'll confirm with her.
Perfect, thanks Allie — Saturday at 3:30 it is. See you then!
Yes — 3:30 Saturday works for me. My study session ends at 15:30, so I'll come straight over. It's on my calendar; go ahead and confirm with Sarah.
Jordan's in — he'll come straight over after his study session. So: Saturday 15:30 at my place, the three of us, coffee and snacks. Both of you are on my calendar.
Great — thanks for sorting it out. Saturday 15:30, see you both there.
